title: Fix the Infinite Countdown
description: The program should count down from 5 to 1 and then stop. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 and then terminate.
actualProblem: n is never changed inside the loop body, so the condition n > 0 stays true forever, producing an infinite loop.
explanation: A while loop only stops once its condition becomes false. The loop body must update the variable being tested (here, decrementing n) or the loop will never end.
